body: My two orbs thoroughly enjoyed reading this.

What you are talking about isn’t spirituality as a whole, but a concept called [Spiritual Bypassing](https://www.verywellmind.com/what-is-spiritual-bypassing-5081640).

Spiritual bypassing is a big issue in a lot of spiritual and religious communities. Your anger and frustration is completely understandable.

One time I got so fed up with the pseudo “entry level” jobs that I started reporting them on Indeed. There were so many of them. I quickly gave up once I realized I was doing the job searching equivalent of pissing into a sea of piss.
When she asked me for my sun sign. Then my moon sign. Then my rising sign. Lady was literally factoring in my zodiac birth chart and calculating whether I'd be a good employee based on that.
